name: Kemangkon

queries.query: Kemangkon Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry public viewer API
queries.result: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS public land-spatial viewer and official Kemangkon village map page were found. No bounded anonymous parcel-ID plus geometry response was verified; the BHUMI console is an embedded application and its current API/configuration was not safely exposed by static inspection.

queries.query: Kemangkon peta bidang tanah pertanahan resmi GIS layanan publik
queries.result: Menemukan portal resmi BHUMI ATR/BPN dan laman peta resmi Desa Kemangkon. Tidak terverifikasi adanya layanan publik lokal yang mengembalikan ID bidang dan geometri secara anonim; peta desa tidak diperlakukan sebagai bukti kadaster.
